documentation.file_docstring:
Trust verification and handshake protocols for AgentMesh.

This module provides trust verification between agents, including
agent cards, handshakes, and scope chains.
inline_comments: Anchor trust to this verifier's identity.
Chain must terminate at the advertised peer identity.
Enforce deterministic linkage between adjacent delegations.
Verify chain linkage (except for first delegation from root)
Check if delegation is still valid
member_docstrings: _canonical_json: Serialize JSON deterministically for signing and verification.
_delegation_signing_payload: Build the canonical delegation payload used for signatures.
_scope_chain_fingerprint: Generate deterministic digest for replay-window tracking.
TrustPolicy: Policy configuration for trust verification.
TrustVerificationResult: Result of a trust verification operation.

TrustedAgentCard: Agent card containing identity and trust information.

Used for agent discovery
Delegation: A delegation of capabilities from one agent to another.
TrustHandshake: Handles trust verification between agents.
DelegationChain: Manages a chain of trust delegations.

AgentDirectory: Local directory for discovering trusted agents.

Provides a framework-level regi

functions.doc: Serialize JSON deterministically for signing and verification.

functions.name: _get_signable_content
functions.doc: Get deterministic content for signing.

functions.name: sign
functions.doc:
Cryptographically sign this card with the given identity.

Args:
    identity: The identity to sign with (must have private key)

functions.name: verify_signature
functions.doc:
Verify the card's signature is valid.

Returns:
    True if signature is valid, False otherwise

functions.name: to_json
functions.doc: Serialize card to JSON-compatible dictionary.

functions.name: from_json
functions.doc: Deserialize card from JSON dictionary.

functions.name: to_dict
functions.doc: Serialize delegation to dictionary.

functions.name: from_dict
functions.doc: Deserialize delegation from dictionary.

functions.name: __init__
functions.doc:
Initialize handshake handler.

Args:
    my_identity: This agent's identity
    policy: Trust policy to apply (uses defaults if not provided)

functions.name: _get_cached_result
functions.doc: Get cached verification result if still valid.

functions.name: _cache_result
functions.doc: Cache a verification result.

functions.name: _prune_seen_scope_chains
functions.doc: Remove scope chain fingerprints outside replay window.

functions.name: _record_scope_chain_fingerprint
functions.doc: Record fingerprint with bounded memory growth.

functions.name: _is_replay_scope_chain
functions.doc: Check replay set membership under lock.

functions.name: _enforce_scope_chain_rate_limit
functions.doc: Bound verification attempts per actor in a sliding window.

functions.name: _scope_chain_failure
functions.doc: Return sanitized error for callers and log detailed reason.

functions.name: _allowed_signature_algorithms
functions.doc: Resolve allowed signature algorithms from policy.

functions.name: verify_scope_chain
functions.doc:
Verify cryptographic validity and effective permissions of a scope chain.

Returns:
    Tuple of ``(is_valid, error_message, effective_capabilities)``.

functions.name: _verify_scope_chain
functions.doc: Verify the peer scope chain and return the effective delegated capabilities.

functions.name: verify_peer
functions.doc:
Verify a peer agent's trustworthiness.

Args:
    peer_card: The peer's agent card
    required_capabilities: Capabilities the peer must have
    min_trust_score: Minimum trust score required

Returns:
    TrustVerificationResult with verification status

functions.name: clear_cache
functions.doc: Clear all cached verification results.

functions.name: __init__
functions.doc:
Initialize scope chain.

Args:
    root_identity: The root authority identity

functions.name: add_delegation
functions.doc:
Add a delegation to the chain.

Args:
    delegatee: The agent receiving the delegation
    capabilities: Capabilities being delegated
    expires_in_hours: Optional expiration time
    delegator_identity: Identity of delegator (root if not specified)

Returns:
    The created Delegation

Raises:
    ValueError: If delegatee lacks identity

functions.name: verify
functions.doc:
Verify the entire scope chain.

Returns:
    True if chain is valid, False otherwise

functions.name: get_delegated_capabilities
functions.doc:
Get capabilities delegated to an agent.

Args:
    agent_did: The agent's DID

Returns:
    List of delegated capabilities

functions.name: __init__
functions.doc: No documentation

functions.name: register
functions.doc:
Register an agent card after verifying its signature.

Args:
    card: The agent card to register

Returns:
    True if registered, False if signature verification failed

functions.name: find_by_did
functions.doc:
Look up an agent by DID.

Args:
    did: The agent's decentralized identifier

Returns:
    The agent card if found, None otherwise

functions.name: find_by_capability
functions.doc:
Find all agents that advertise a specific capability.

Args:
    capability: The capability to search for

Returns:
    List of agent cards with the capability

functions.name: list_trusted
functions.doc:
List all agents above a minimum trust score.

Args:
    min_trust_score: Minimum trust score threshold

Returns:
    List of trusted agent cards

functions.name: remove
functions.doc:
Remove an agent from the directory.

Args:
    did: The agent's DID

Returns:
    True if removed, False if not found

functions.name: count
functions.doc: Return number of registered agents.

classes.name: AgentDirectory
classes.doc:
Local directory for discovering trusted agents.

Provides a framework-level registry so agents can find each other
by DID or capability without a centralized service dependency.
Pairs with the core AgentMesh Registry for production deployments.
